analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a micro-physiological system (MPS) that can model respiratory viral infections and support antiviral discovery by recapitulating tissue architecture and immune competence.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study created an airway spheroid-based MPS using oxidized cellulose nanofiber (OCNF) hydrogel, which supports stable long-term 3D culture and allows for longitudinal analysis of influenza A virus replication and host immune responses.
analysis.methods: Airway epithelial-like spheroids were generated from Calu-3 cells or as immunocompetent co-cultures with polarized THP-1 macrophage-like cells. The OCNF hydrogel platform enabled rapid spheroid self-assembly within 6 days and preserved structural integrity for ≥ 20 days.
analysis.main_results: The OCNF hydrogel platform allowed for the rapid self-assembly of airway spheroids within 6 days and maintained their structural integrity for at least 20 days, facilitating longitudinal study of influenza A virus replication and host immune responses.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The model demonstrated that human bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) have potent antiviral activity against influenza A virus, significantly reducing infection through activation of IFN-associated pathways.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings establish an in vitro platform for preclinical evaluation of antiviral interventions and offer a scalable method for personalized respiratory infection models relevant to seasonal influenza.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro models and does not include in vivo validation, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate due to the absence of clinical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces an oxidized cellulose nanofiber (OCNF) hydrogel platform that supports the creation of airway spheroid-based micro-physiological systems (MPS) for modeling respiratory viral infections. The OCNF hydrogel enables rapid spheroid self-assembly within 6 days and maintains structural integrity for at least 20 days, allowing for longitudinal analysis of influenza A virus replication and host immune responses. The model reveals that human bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) exhibit potent antiviral activity against influenza A virus by activating IFN-associated pathways. These findings provide a scalable and reproducible in vitro platform for preclinical evaluation of antiviral interventions and personalized respiratory infection models. papers.title_zh: 用于 3D 气道球体和流感感染建模的氧化纤维素纳米纤维水凝胶
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Micro‐physiological systems (MPS) that recapitulate tissue architecture and immune competence are urgently needed to model respiratory viral infections and accelerate antiviral discovery. Here, we create an airway spheroid‐based MPS supported by an oxidized cellulose nanofiber (OCNF) hydrogel, which provides a hydrated, extracellular matrix (ECM) mimetic nanofibrillar microenvironment and supports stable long‐term 3D culture. Airway epithelial‐like spheroids are generated either from Calu‐3 cells alone or as immunocompetent co‐culture spheroids incorporating polarized THP‐1 macrophage‐like cells to capture epithelial‐immune crosstalk. The OCNF platform promotes rapid spheroid self‐assembly within 6 days and preserves structural integrity for ≥ 20 days, allowing longitudinal interrogation of influenza A virus replication and host innate immune responses. Notably, the model reveals that human bone marrow‐derived mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) exert potent antiviral activity, significantly reducing influenza infection through activation of interferon (IFN)‐associated pathways, including MX1, OAS1, and STAT1. Together, this OCNF hydrogel‐enabled airway spheroid MPS provides a scalable and reproducible test‐bed for mechanistic studies and preclinical evaluation of antiviral interventions and establishes an in vitro platform toward personalized patient‐relevant respiratory infection models.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:迫切需要能够概括组织结构和免疫能力的微生理系统(MPS)来模拟呼吸道病毒感染并加速 抗病毒药物 的发现。在这里,我们创建了一种基于气道球体的 MPS,由氧化纤维素纳米纤维 (OCNF) 水凝胶支持,它提供了水合的细胞外基质 (ECM) 模拟纳米纤维微环境,并支持稳定的长期 3D 培养。气道上皮样球体可以单独由 Calu-3 细胞生成,也可以作为包含极化 THP-1 巨噬细胞样细胞的免疫活性共培养球体生成,以捕获上皮免疫串扰。OCNF 平台可在 6 天内促进球体快速自组装,并保持结构完整性 ≥ 20 天,从而允许对甲型流感病毒复制和 宿主 固有 免疫应答 进行纵向询问。值得注意的是,该模型揭示人骨髓间充质干细胞 (MSC) 发挥有效的 抗病毒药物 活性,通过激活干扰素 (IFN) 相关途径(包括 MX1、OAS1 和 STAT1)显着减少流感感染。总之,这种支持 OCNF 水凝胶的气道球体 MPS 为 抗病毒药物 干预措施的机械研究和临床前评估提供了可扩展且可重复的测试平台,并建立了一个针对个性化患者相关呼吸道感染模型的体外平台。

papers.title: Ethyl caffeate restores BNIP3L-dependent mitophagy and mitochondrial function to ameliorate influenza A virus-induced lung injury
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection induces severe lung injury characterized by excessive inflammation and mitochondrial dysfunction, in which impaired mitochondrial clearance plays a crucial role. Ethyl caffeate (EC), a bioactive phenolic compound of dietary origin, exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, its protective role against IAV-triggered lung damage and mitochondrial quality control dysfunction remains poorly defined. In this study, PR8-induced IAV infection models was established in mice and cells to evaluate the protective effects of EC. EC treatment improved survival outcomes, markedly alleviated lung injury in a manner independent of direct viral inhibition, reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression, and improved mitochondrial function. Mechanistically, EC rescued the impaired autophagy flux induced by IAV infection, as evidenced by reduced p62 accumulation and enhanced mitochondrial clearance, and this effect required intact lysosomal degradation activity. Proteomic analysis further identified BNIP3L as a key regulator, and genetic knockdown of BNIP3L largely abolished EC-mediated protective phenotypes. EC significantly upregulated BNIP3L expression to promote mitochondrial clearance and maintain mitochondrial homeostasis. Metabolomic analysis showed that EC markedly reshaped host metabolic profiles associated with mitochondrial function in lung, with trigonelline identified as a key metabolite upon EC intervention. Functional experiments demonstrated that trigonelline recapitulated EC-like protective effects by facilitating autophagosome-lysosome fusion to restore BNIP3L-dependent mitochondrial clearance and attenuating inflammatory responses both in vitro and in vivo . Overall, EC alleviates IAV-induced lung injury by restoring BNIP3L-mediated mitochondrial clearance and mitochondrial homeostasis. Trigonelline serves as a functional metabolite and metabolic signature of this protective process, highlighting a potential link between plant-derived phenolic compounds, mitochondrial clearance regulation, and host metabolic reprogramming during viral infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the protective effects of ethyl caffeate (EC) against influenza A virus (IAV)-induced lung injury. It demonstrates that EC alleviates lung damage by restoring mitochondrial function and BNIP3L-dependent mitophagy. The research highlights the role of EC in reducing inflammation and improving mitochondrial homeostasis through autophagy flux and lysosomal degradation. Metabolomic analysis identifies trigonelline as a key metabolite involved in EC's protective mechanism. The findings suggest EC as a potential therapeutic agent for IAV-related lung injury, emphasizing the importance of mitochondrial quality control during viral infections. However, the study is limited to animal and cell models, and further research is needed to validate these results in humans.

papers.source_body_en: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection induces severe lung injury characterized by excessive inflammation and mitochondrial dysfunction, in which impaired mitochondrial clearance plays a crucial role. Ethyl caffeate (EC), a bioactive phenolic compound of dietary origin, exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, its protective role against IAV-triggered lung damage and mitochondrial quality control dysfunction remains poorly defined. In this study, PR8-induced IAV infection models was established in mice and cells to evaluate the protective effects of EC. EC treatment improved survival outcomes, markedly alleviated lung injury in a manner independent of direct viral inhibition, reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression, and improved mitochondrial function. Mechanistically, EC rescued the impaired autophagy flux induced by IAV infection, as evidenced by reduced p62 accumulation and enhanced mitochondrial clearance, and this effect required intact lysosomal degradation activity. Proteomic analysis further identified BNIP3L as a key regulator, and genetic knockdown of BNIP3L largely abolished EC-mediated protective phenotypes. EC significantly upregulated BNIP3L expression to promote mitochondrial clearance and maintain mitochondrial homeostasis. Metabolomic analysis showed that EC markedly reshaped host metabolic profiles associated with mitochondrial function in lung, with trigonelline identified as a key metabolite upon EC intervention. Functional experiments demonstrated that trigonelline recapitulated EC-like protective effects by facilitating autophagosome-lysosome fusion to restore BNIP3L-dependent mitochondrial clearance and attenuating inflammatory responses both in vitro and in vivo . Overall, EC alleviates IAV-induced lung injury by restoring BNIP3L-mediated mitochondrial clearance and mitochondrial homeostasis. Trigonelline serves as a functional metabolite and metabolic signature of this protective process, highlighting a potential link between plant-derived phenolic compounds, mitochondrial clearance regulation, and host metabolic reprogramming during viral infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒(IAV)感染会引起严重的肺损伤,其特征是过度炎症和线粒体功能障碍,其中线粒体清除功能受损起着至关重要的作用。咖啡酸乙酯 (EC) 是一种源自膳食的生物活性酚类化合物,具有有效的抗炎和抗氧化特性。然而,其对 IAV 引发的肺损伤和线粒体质量控制功能障碍的保护作用仍不清楚。本研究在小鼠和细胞中建立了PR8诱导的IAV感染模型,以评估EC的保护作用。EC 治疗 改善了生存结果,以独立于直接病毒抑制的方式显着减轻了肺损伤,减少了促炎细胞因子的表达,并改善了线粒体功能。从机制上讲,EC 挽救了 IAV 感染引起的受损自噬流,p62 积累减少和线粒体清除增强证明了这一点,而这种作用需要完整的溶酶体降解活性。蛋白质组学分析进一步确定 BNIP3L 是一个关键的调节因子,并且 BNIP3L 的基因敲除很大程度上消除了 EC 介导的保护表型。EC 显着上调 BNIP3L 表达,促进线粒体清除并维持线粒体稳态。代谢组学分析表明,EC 显着重塑了与肺线粒体功能相关的 宿主 代谢谱,葫芦巴碱被确定为 EC 干预后的关键代谢物。功能实验表明,葫芦巴碱通过促进自噬体-溶酶体融合来恢复 BNIP3L 依赖性线粒体清除并减弱体外和体内炎症反应,从而重现 EC 样保护作用。总体而言,EC 通过恢复 BNIP3L 介导的线粒体清除和线粒体稳态来减轻 IAV 引起的肺损伤。葫芦巴碱作为这一保护过程的功能代谢物和代谢特征,突显了植物源性酚类化合物、线粒体清除调节和病毒感染期间 宿主 代谢重编程之间的潜在联系。

papers.title: The Effect of Prevaccination Analgesics on Influenza Vaccine Immunogenicity and Effectiveness.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Analgesic medications are sometimes taken prior to vaccination to prevent local and systemic adverse reactions. Although studies have examined the association between postvaccination analgesic use and immunogenicity, few have evaluated the effects of prevaccination analgesic use. This analysis assessed antibody response, influenza-like illness (ILI), and influenza infection among adults with and without analgesic use before influenza vaccination. METHODS: The Pragmatic Assessment of Influenza Vaccine Effectiveness in the DoD (PAIVED) study was an open-label, randomized trial evaluating the effectiveness of FDA-licensed influenza vaccines during 4 influenza seasons in adult military healthcare beneficiaries. PAIVED participants with data on analgesic use within 24 hours before vaccination were included in this analysis if they either provided prevaccination and postvaccination venous blood samples or participated in weekly ILI surveillance. RESULTS: Among 684 PAIVED participants with prevaccination and postvaccination antibody titers, 10.4% (n = 71) reported analgesic use before influenza vaccination. Multivariable analyses showed no association between analgesic use and geometric mean titer fold change. There was a modest association between acetaminophen use and increased seroconversion to influenza A/H3N2 compared with no analgesic use (aIRR = 1.37; P = .022); however, this association was not significant in sensitivity analyses adjusting for multiple comparisons. Among 10 723 PAIVED participants with ILI surveillance data, 10.6% (n = 1140) reported prevaccination analgesic use. Multivariable analyses revealed no association between analgesic use and incidence of ILI or odds of influenza infection. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest acetaminophen and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory analgesic use within 24 hours before influenza vaccination does not reduce vaccine immunogenicity or effectiveness in adults.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 有时在 疫苗接种 之前服用镇痛药物,以防止局部和全身不良反应。尽管研究已经检验了疫苗接种后镇痛剂使用与免疫原性之间的关联,但很少有人评估疫苗接种前镇痛剂使用的效果。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 国防部流感 疫苗 有效性的实用评估 (PAIVED) 研究是一项开放标签、随机试验,评估 FDA 许可的流感 疫苗 在 4 个流感季节对成年军事医疗保健受益人的有效性。在 疫苗接种 之前 24 小时内拥有镇痛使用数据的 PAIVED 参与者,如果他们提供了疫苗接种前和疫苗接种后静脉血样本或参加了每周 ILI 监测,则纳入本分析。
elements_zh.methods: 该分析评估了流感 疫苗接种 之前使用或未使用镇痛剂的成年人的抗体反应、流感样疾病 (ILI) 和流感感染。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 684 名接种前和接种后抗体滴度的 PAIVED 参与者中,10.4% (n = 71) 报告在流感 疫苗接种 之前使用了镇痛剂。多变量分析显示镇痛剂的使用与几何平均滴度倍数变化之间没有关联。与不使用镇痛剂相比,使用对乙酰氨基酚与 A/H3N2 流感血清转化增加之间存在适度关联(aIRR = 1.37;P = .022);然而,这种关联在调整多重比较的敏感性分析中并不显着。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,在流感 疫苗接种 发生前 24 小时内使用对乙酰氨基酚和/或非甾体抗炎镇痛药不会降低 疫苗 成人的免疫原性或有效性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,疫苗接种前使用镇痛药不会损害成人流感 疫苗 的免疫原性或有效性,从而为公共卫生实践提供谨慎的信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于自我报告的镇痛药物使用情况以及可能存在的混杂因素。由于分析的观察性质和敏感性调整的需要,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Three-Year Polymerase Chain Reaction-Based Surveillance of Respiratory Tract Infections in Adults and Seasonal Patterns.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective: This study investigated the aetiological composition, seasonal variation and risk factors of adult respiratory tract infections in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, during 2023–2025. Methods: A total of 8,493 adults (≥18 years) with respiratory symptoms were enrolled from a tertiary hospital during 2023–2025. Oropharyngeal and nasopharyngeal swabs were tested using multiplex real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR) panels targeting six categories of seven respiratory pathogens: influenza A and B viruses, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), parainfluenza virus types I and III, adenovirus and Mycoplasma pneumoniae. Mixed infections (two or more pathogens) were reported separately. Data were analysed by univariate analysis and multivariate logistic regression. Results: The overall pathogen detection rate was 4.14% (352/8,493), comprising 325 single infections (92.33%) and 27 mixed infections (7.67%). Among single infections, M. pneumoniae (39.69%), influenza A virus (28.00%) and RSV (16.00%) predominated. Infections peaked in winter–spring (December–March). Age ≥65 years (OR = 2.35, 95% CI: 1.78–3.09), underlying diseases (OR = 2.41, 95% CI: 1.89–3.08) and emergency department admission (OR = 1.58, 95% CI: 1.24–2.01) were independent risk factors. Conclusion: Adult respiratory infections in Ganzhou show clear winter–spring seasonality, with M. pneumoniae, influenza A virus and RSV as leading pathogens. These findings support seasonally targeted surveillance – with enhanced monitoring for M. pneumoniae and influenza during winter–spring months – and prioritised vaccination, expanded diagnostic panels and early PCR-based diagnosis for adults aged ≥65 years and those with underlying diseases, thereby strengthening local respiratory infection prevention and control strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a three-year polymerase chain reaction-based surveillance of respiratory tract infections in adults in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, from 2023 to 2025. papers.title: Individual Preferences for Influenza Vaccine in Iran: A Discrete Choice Experiment.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Influenza vaccination is a key preventive measure against seasonal influenza. Understanding public preferences for influenza vaccine attributes is essential for designing effective vaccination strategies. This study examined individuals’ preferences for influenza vaccine attributes in Iran and identified factors associated with vaccine choice. Methods A discrete choice experiment (DCE) was conducted among 226 adults in Tehran province between September and December 2024. Seven vaccine attributes were evaluated: effectiveness, risk of severe side effects, risk of mild side effects, number of doses, duration of protection, location of manufacture, and price. Conditional and mixed logit models were used to estimate participants’ preferences, and model performance was assessed using the log‐likelihood, Akaike information criterion (AIC), and Bayesian information criterion (BIC). Results Vaccines with higher effectiveness were more likely to be selected, whereas higher risks of severe side effects and higher prices were associated with a lower likelihood of vaccine selection. The risk of mild side effects, duration of protection, and location of manufacture showed limited or no association with vaccine choice in the conditional logit model, although the mixed logit model suggested a lower preference for domestically manufactured vaccines. Preference heterogeneity was observed, with age, marital status, education, and health insurance status being associated with differences in preferences for specific vaccine attributes. Conclusion Vaccine effectiveness, safety, and affordability appeared to be the most important attributes associated with influenza vaccine choice in this study. These findings suggest that public health strategies emphasizing vaccine effectiveness and safety while improving affordability may help increase influenza vaccine uptake in Iran.

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Influenza vaccination is a key preventive measure against seasonal influenza. Understanding public preferences for influenza vaccine attributes is essential for designing effective vaccination strategies. This study examined individuals’ preferences for influenza vaccine attributes in Iran and identified factors associated with vaccine choice. Methods A discrete choice experiment (DCE) was conducted among 226 adults in Tehran province between September and December 2024. Seven vaccine attributes were evaluated: effectiveness, risk of severe side effects, risk of mild side effects, number of doses, duration of protection, location of manufacture, and price. Conclusion Vaccine effectiveness, safety, and affordability appeared to be the most important attributes associated with influenza vaccine choice in this study. These findings suggest that public health strategies emphasizing vaccine effectiveness and safety while improving affordability may help increase influenza vaccine uptake in Iran.

papers.title: Climate-Driven Perturbations in Influenza Subtype Positivity Before and After the COVID-19 Pandemic: Observational Study.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The COVID-19 pandemic significantly altered global influenza transmission patterns. Whether the associations among meteorological conditions, visibility, and influenza subtype (A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria) positivity changed after the pandemic remains unclear. We compared these associations before and after the COVID-19 pandemic in northern China. Objective This study aimed to characterize changes in the associations of meteorological variables and visibility with influenza subtype positivity before and after the COVID-19 pandemic and to identify subtype-specific nonlinear patterns and thresholds. Methods Using 13 years of influenza surveillance and environmental data, we applied Extreme Gradient Boosting enhanced with Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) to characterize the relative importance and direction of associations between environmental variables and influenza subtype positivity. Generalized additive models (GAMs) were subsequently used to characterize nonlinear association patterns and identify thresholds at which the direction of model-estimated associations changed. Results Absolute humidity (AH) remained the most influential environmental factor for A/H3N2 and A/H1N1, accounting for 32.2% and 38.5% of relative feature importance, respectively. Visibility increased in importance after the pandemic, rising from being the fourth to the second most influential environmental indicator. GAM analysis identified thresholds corresponding to points where the direction of the associations changed. For A/H3N2, AH below 4 g/m 3 was associated with positive SHAP values, whereas higher AH was predominantly associated with negative SHAP values. For A/H1N1, the direction of association changed at an AH threshold of 4.5 g/m 3 (95% CI 4.0-4.8) in the postpandemic period. Additionally, relative humidity (RH) demonstrated a complex nonlinear association with A/H3N2 positivity, with transition points at 45.1% (95% CI 43.5%-46.1%) and 69.7% (95% CI 69.2%-70.2%) in the prepandemic period and at 48.7% (95% CI 46.7%-50.4%) and 70.6% (95% CI 66.3%-72.6%) in the postpandemic period. RH values within these ranges were associated with negative SHAP values, whereas values outside these ranges were associated with positive SHAP values. In contrast, visibility showed opposing association patterns for the A/H3N2 and B/Victoria subtypes after the pandemic. Visibility below 17.1 km (95% CI 16.3-17.4) was associated with negative SHAP values for A/H3N2, whereas visibility below 18.4 km (95% CI 18.0-18.9) was associated with positive SHAP values for B/Victoria. Conclusions AH remained a key environmental determinant of influenza A subtype positivity, while visibility became more important after the pandemic and showed opposing association patterns for A/H3N2 and B/Victoria. The identified nonlinear thresholds highlight subtype-specific environmental associations and may inform influenza surveillance and risk assessment under changing environmental conditions.

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为流感 监测 和不断变化的环境条件下的风险评估提供信息,特别是了解大流行相关的变化如何影响亚型特定的环境关联。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是观察性的,基于环境和 监测 数据,可能会引入偏差和混杂因素。证据是强有力的,因为它使用了先进的统计方法,并为环境协会提供了具体的阈值。

papers.title: Epidemiologic Variability and Clinical Severity Across 11 Influenza Seasons in Children.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza is a major cause of respiratory illness, contributing substantially to morbidity and mortality in children. Seasonal influenza epidemics were profoundly disrupted by the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic. Whether the clinical presentation and disease severity differ according to influenza virus type and subtype remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to describe temporal changes in epidemiology, clinical characteristics, outcomes and healthcare utilization among laboratory-confirmed pediatric influenza cases over 11 seasons and to explore associations between virus type/subtype and clinically important outcomes. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective observational study at a tertiary pediatric hospital, including all laboratory-confirmed influenza cases identified in children presenting with acute respiratory infection between July 2015 and June 2026, and analyzed the distribution of cases and their demographic and clinical characteristics. RESULTS: Influenza was detected in 3105 children (median age, 4 years), the majority of whom were previously healthy (82.4%). Within this cohort, hospitalization was required in 17.9% of cases, with 1.1% requiring intensive care admission, and 22.8% developing complications, including encephalitis and sepsis. Influenza circulation patterns, including the timing of peak activity and the duration of annual epidemics, varied over time. After an 18-month absence of reported cases during the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2021-2022 season was marked by a substantial resurgence, followed by 2 years of atypical year-round circulation before returning to the usual seasonal pattern. Influenza A accounted for 72.3% of cases, with alternating predominance of virus types and subtypes without a consistent epidemiologic pattern. In a restricted type/subtype analysis, influenza A(H1N1) cases had a higher frequency of hospitalization and recorded moderate-to-severe complications, and this association remained statistically significant after multivariable analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza was associated with clinically important illness and healthcare use among children in this hospital-based cohort, most commonly among otherwise healthy children, highlighting the importance of influenza prevention strategies. During and after the COVID-19 pandemic, influenza epidemiology changed markedly, underscoring the need for continued surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the epidemiologic variability and clinical severity of influenza across 11 seasons in children, focusing on seasonal influenza viruses. It highlights the changing patterns of influenza circulation, particularly during and after the COVID-19 pandemic, and the association between influenza A(H1N1) and higher hospitalization rates and complications. The study is based on a retrospective observational design at a tertiary pediatric hospital, analyzing laboratory-confirmed cases from 2015 to 2026. The results show that influenza A accounted for the majority of cases, with varying predominance of subtypes. The findings emphasize the need for ongoing surveillance and prevention strategies, especially for otherwise healthy children who are most affected. The evidence is strong, with a high confidence rating, but the study design is limited to a single hospital setting, which may affect generalizability.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:流感是呼吸系统疾病的主要原因,极大地增加了儿童的发病率和 死亡率。季节性流感 流行病受到 2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19) 大流行的严重破坏。临床表现和疾病严重程度是否因流感病毒类型和亚型而异仍不完全清楚。本研究旨在描述 11 个季节内实验室确诊的儿科流感病例中 流行病学、临床特征、结果和医疗保健利用的时间变化,并探讨病毒类型/亚型与临床重要结果之间的关联。方法:我们对某三级儿科医院2015年7月至2026年6月期间所有实验室确诊的急性呼吸道感染儿童流感病例进行回顾性观察研究,分析病例分布及其人口学和临床特征。结果:3105 名儿童(中位年龄为 4 岁)中检测出流感,其中大多数先前健康(82.4%)。在该 队列研究 中,17.9% 的病例需要住院治疗,其中 1.1% 需要入院重症监护,22.8% 出现并发症,包括脑炎和败血症。流感的传播模式,包括高峰活动的时间和年度流行病的持续时间,随着时间的推移而变化。在 COVID-19 大流行期间连续 18 个月没有报告病例后,2021-2022 年季节出现了大幅复苏,随后经历了 2 年的非典型全年循环,然后又恢复到通常的季节模式。甲型流感占病例的 72.3%,病毒类型和亚型交替为主,没有一致的流行病学模式。在限制型/亚型分析中,甲型H1N1流感病例的住院频率较高,并有中重度并发症,且在多变量分析后这种关联仍具有统计学显着性。结论:流感与 队列研究 医院儿童的临床重要疾病和医疗保健使用相关,最常见于其他健康儿童,这凸显了流感预防策略的重要性。在 COVID-19 大流行期间和之后,流感 流行病学 发生了显着变化,强调了继续使用 监测 的必要性。

papers.title: Influenza Vaccination and Disease Severity Among Older Adults Hospitalized with Influenza in France: A Nationwide Cohort Study, 2016-2024
papers.abstract: Objective: Seasonal influenza remains a major cause of severe morbidity and mortality among older adults, despite vaccine availability. We assessed whether influenza vaccination was associated with reduced disease severity among adults aged 65 years or more hospitalized with influenza in France. Methods and Analysis We conducted a nationwide retrospective cohort study using the French National Health Data System (SNDS). Adults aged 65 years or more hospitalized with confirmed influenza (ICD-10 codes: J09 or J10) between October 2016 and December 2024 were included, excluding 2020-2021. Vaccination status was identified from reimbursed community pharmacy dispensing records. Entropy balancing was used to balance sociodemographic characteristics, chronic conditions pneumococcal vaccination, and COVID-19 vaccination. Weighted regression models estimated adjusted risk ratios (aRRs) for invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV), intensive care unit (ICU) admission, in-hospital death, and a composite severe outcome. Multistate survival models assessed transitions specific hazard ratios (HR) between hospitalization, ICU, discharge, and in-hospital death. Results Among 132,443 influenza-associated hospitalizations, 72,852 (55%) occurred among vaccinated patients and 59,591 (45%) among unvaccinated patients. Vaccinated patients were older (mean age, 82.3 vs 79.3 years). IMV occurred in 2128 vaccinated (2.9%) and 2544 unvaccinated (4.3%) hospitalizations (aRR, 0.88; 95%CI: 0.83 to 0.93). In-hospital death occurred in 6300 (8.6%) and 4952 (8.3%), respectively (aRR, 0.90; 95%CI: 0.87 to 0.93). Vaccination was also associated with a lower risk of the composite outcome (aRR, 0.96; 95%CI: 0.94 to 0.98), but not ICU admission (aRR, 0.99; 95%CI: 0.96 to 1.01). Among patients admitted to ICU, vaccination was associated with a lower hazard of death (adjusted hazard ratio, 0.85; 95%CI: 0.78 to 0.92) and a 2-day reduction in the median time to discharge. Conclusion In this nationwide cohort study, influenza vaccination was associated with lower risks of IMV and in-hospital death among older adults hospitalized with influenza. These findings are consistent with possible attenuation of disease severity and support efforts to improve influenza vaccination among older adults.

papers.title: Reconstructing substitution histories on phylogenies, with accuracy, precision, and coverage.
papers.abstract: Ancestral sequences and substitution histories are usually averaged out in phylogenetic inference and are therefore not reported to the user. However, they can be recovered through ancestral sequence reconstruction (ASR) and stochastic character mapping. By implementing and validating a new ASR and stochastic mapping package compatible with both single-locus and multispecies coalescent analysis, we show how reconstructing substitution histories can enhance the information gained about the tempo and mode of molecular evolution. We observe that known substitution histories (simulated and empirical) are recovered more accurately and precisely on time trees compared with unconstrained and non-ultrametric substitution trees that lack temporal directionality (maximum likelihood and Bayesian). We show that codon-partition models with site-rate heterogeneity, based on the four nucleotide characters, can effectively approximate the histories of synonymous and non-synonymous change, while requiring far less runtime than computationally demanding codon models that require 61 characters. In turn, this provides low-bias estimation of dN/dS that is robust to non-stationarity in GC content, codon usage bias, and nucleotide exchangeability rates. Lastly, using three case studies, we demonstrate how the approach can recover expected patterns in molecular evolution and pathogen transmission: that i) smaller-bodied mammalian species tend to have faster synonymous substitution rates than larger relatives, ii) amino acid substitutions are correlated with 3Di structural changes in aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases, and iii) influenza A virus spread more frequently to nearby locations than distant ones, in a major H3N2 outbreak in New Zealand. These three trends were more pronounced when based on count estimates derived from stochastic mapping, relative to parametric rates and distances. Our open-source code comes with a user-friendly graphical interface, as the BeastMap package for BEAST 2; supporting a wide range of clock, site, and tree models and data types - including insertions and deletions - within a Bayesian phylogenetic framework.

papers.abstract_zh: 祖先序列和替代历史通常在系统发育推断中进行平均,因此不会报告给用户。然而,它们可以通过祖先序列重建(ASR)和随机字符映射来恢复。通过实施和验证与单位点和多物种聚结分析兼容的新 ASR 和随机作图包,我们展示了重建取代历史如何增强获得的有关分子 进化 的节奏和模式的信息。我们观察到,与缺乏时间方向性(最大似然和贝叶斯)的无约束和非超度量替代树相比,已知的替代历史(模拟和经验)在时间树上恢复得更准确和精确。我们表明,基于四个核苷酸字符的具有位点速率异质性的密码子划分模型可以有效地近似同义和非同义变化的历史,同时比需要 61 个字符的计算要求高的密码子模型所需的运行时间要少得多。反过来,这提供了 dN/dS 的低偏差估计,对 GC 含量、密码子使用偏差和核苷酸交换率的非平稳性具有鲁棒性。最后,通过三个案例研究,我们证明了该方法如何恢复分子 进化 和病原体 传播 的预期模式:i) 体型较小的哺乳动物物种往往比体型较大的亲属具有更快的同义替换率,ii) 氨基酸替换与氨酰基-tRNA 合成酶中的 3Di 结构变化相关,以及 iii) 在主要的 H3N2 病毒中,甲型流感病毒传播到附近的位置比远处的位置更频繁新西兰的 暴发。当基于随机映射得出的计数估计(相对于参数率和距离)时,这三种趋势更加明显。我们的开源代码带有用户友好的图形界面,如BEAST 2的BeastMap包;在贝叶斯系统发育框架内支持各种时钟、位点和树模型和数据类型(包括插入和删除)。

papers.title: Outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic: decline of functional independence and frailty.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza remains a heavy burden to the elderly and the situation has been affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The objective of this study was to clarify outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic. METHODS: The clinical data of patients 65 years of age or older who were severely ill with influenza and required hospitalization in one center were gathered between September 2023 and March 2026 (3 influenza seasons after the COVID-19 pandemic). The outcomes, functional independence, and frailty of them were analyzed. RESULTS: A total of 210 elderly patients were enrolled. The median age was 79 and 32 cases were judged as having mild or more frailty by the clinical frailty scale (CFS) before admission. Pneumonia was the most common disease indicated as cause for hospitalization, followed by a poor general condition and heart failure. The median duration of hospitalization was 13 days and in-hospital deaths were recorded for 17 patients (8.1%). Sixty cases changed hospital due to further treatment or deterioration of activity of daily living, and the functional independence measure (FIM) of 37 cases (17.6%) remained under a score of 70 even after rehabilitation. The CFSs worsened in 19 cases (9.0%) at the time of discharge. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza infection remains a heavy burden among the elderly after the COVID-19 pandemic. The elderly tend to lose functional independence and fail to frailty even after recovery from acute illness. Preventive measures for influenza to avoid admission, including vaccination, will be essential. (Influenza Internet Survey, UMIN000015989).

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic. It highlights that influenza remains a significant burden for the elderly, with functional independence and frailty being major concerns even after recovery. The study found that 8.1% of patients experienced in-hospital deaths, and 17.6% had functional independence scores below 70 post-rehabilitation. The authors emphasize the importance of preventive measures, such as vaccination, to reduce the risk of hospitalization. The evidence is based on data collected from one center over three influenza seasons post-pandemic, and the findings suggest a continued need for targeted interventions in this vulnerable population. However, the study does not provide information on its limitations, which may affect the confidence in its conclusions.

papers.title: Comparison of Dissemination of Aerosol and Splatter during Ultrasonic Scaling using Different Masks: A Pilot Study with Relevance to Respiratory Infection Transmission
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Dentists are routinely exposed to a high amount of micro-organism load due to primarily being responsible for the treatment of the structures if the mouth – which is a well-known source of huge bacterial loads. Also, as COVID-19 recently affected the entire world, masks thus were considered to act as a comprehensive strategy of measures to suppress transmission. However, the relevance of aerosol and respiratory infection control extends beyond COVID-19, as respiratory pathogens including seasonal influenza viruses such as influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, commonly referred to as swine flu, influenza A(H3N2), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and other respiratory viruses continue to circulate and may be transmitted through respiratory particles. Aim: To compare the dissemination of aerosol and splatter during ultrasonic scaling using different masks. Method: In this study we evaluated the dissemination of four masks that is N-95 with respirator, N-95 without respirator, a combination of cloth mask and N-95 without respirator, and normal surgical mask by calculating the surface are of filter paper with the help of a previously marked scale which was divided into one-centimeter squares. Results: Best protection was seen to be offered by the combined use of the double masking – N-95 without filter plus cloth mask, followed by N-95 mask alone and then the surgical mask.

papers.title: Influenza Attack Rates and Vaccine Effectiveness by Prior-Season Infection and Vaccination: A 17-Season Analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Vaccine effectiveness (VE) is commonly interpreted as a measure of protection but may be influenced by differences in baseline risk across populations. The effects of prior-season influenza infection and vaccination on both attack rates (ARs) and VE have not been fully characterized. METHODS: We analyzed 148 108 person-seasons from a 17-season prospective, community-based cohort study in Japan (2002-2003 through 2018-2019). Influenza infection was confirmed using rapid antigen testing. Attack rates among current-season unvaccinated individuals (a proxy for baseline risk) and vaccinated individuals were compared across groups defined by prior-season infection and vaccination. Adjusted odds ratios (aORs) and relative aORs for current-season vaccination were estimated using multivariable logistic regression, with laboratory-confirmed influenza A infection (yes/no) as the outcome. RESULTS: Among current-season unvaccinated individuals, ARs were higher in those with prior-season vaccination than in those without (14.0% vs 8.6% in children; P < .001). Attack rates were similar regardless of prior-season infection but higher with prior-season vaccination. Current-season vaccination reduced odds of influenza A infection (aOR, 0.52; 95% CI, .47-.57). This reduction was more pronounced among individuals with prior-season infection (aOR, 0.35; 95% CI, .25-.49) and less pronounced among those with prior-season vaccination (aOR, 0.59; 95% CI, .50-.70). Protection remained across all groups (aOR < 1). CONCLUSIONS: Prior-season infection was associated with enhanced VE of current-season vaccination and similar ARs among vaccinated individuals, whereas prior-season vaccination was associated with attenuated but effective VE. These findings highlight the importance of interpreting AR alongside VE, as ARs reflect differences in baseline risk.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Vaccine effectiveness (VE) is commonly interpreted as a measure of protection but may be influenced by differences in baseline risk across populations. The effects of prior-season influenza infection and vaccination on both attack rates (ARs) and VE have not been fully characterized. METHODS: We analyzed 148 108 person-seasons from a 17-season prospective, community-based cohort study in Japan (2002-2003 through 2018-2019). Influenza infection was confirmed using rapid antigen testing. Attack rates among current-season unvaccinated individuals (a proxy for baseline risk) and vaccinated individuals were compared across groups defined by prior-season infection and vaccination. Adjusted odds ratios (aORs) and relative aORs for current-season vaccination were estimated using multivariable logistic regression, with laboratory-confirmed influenza A infection (yes/no) as the outcome. RESULTS: Among current-season unvaccinated individuals, ARs were higher in those with prior-season vaccination than in those without (14.0% vs 8.6% in children; P < .001). Attack rates were similar regardless of prior-season infection but higher with prior-season vaccination. Current-season vaccination reduced odds of influenza A infection (aOR, 0.52; 95% CI, .47-.57). This reduction was more pronounced among individuals with prior-season infection (aOR, 0.35; 95% CI, .25-.49) and less pronounced among those with prior-season vaccination (aOR, 0.59; 95% CI, .50-.70). Protection remained across all groups (aOR < 1). CONCLUSIONS: Prior-season infection was associated with enhanced VE of current-season vaccination and similar ARs among vaccinated individuals, whereas prior-season vaccination was associated with attenuated but effective VE. These findings highlight the importance of interpreting AR alongside VE, as ARs reflect differences in baseline risk.

papers.title: Targeting TMPRSS2 protects against influenza-associated lung injury by suppressing PAR-2/MMP-9 axis
papers.abstract: Severe acute lung injury (ALI) induced by influenza A virus is characterized by alveolar hyperpermeability, in which matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) is closely associated with extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation and epithelial barrier compromise. However, the host regulatory mechanism involved in virus-associated MMP-9 upregulation remain incompletely understood. In this study, we investigated the potential involvement of the host protease TMPRSS2 and its downstream partner protease-activated receptor-2 (PAR-2) in modulating MMP-9 expression during A/WSN/33(H1N1) infection. Our findings indicate that viral infection is accompanied by TMPRSS2-mediated PAR-2 activation, alongside downstream engagement of the MEK/ERK and PI3K/AKT signaling pathways and enhanced NF-κB activity, correlating with elevated MMP-9 levels. Pharmacological inhibition of TMPRSS2 with Camostat suppressed PAR-2 activation, attenuated downstream kinase phosphorylation in vitro and in vivo, and was associated with reduced MMP-9 production. Importantly, without apparent alterations in pulmonary viral replication kinetics, TMPRSS2 inhibition helped preserve ECM integrity, mitigated transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER) decline, attenuated alveolar vascular leakage, and reduced inflammatory cytokine release and leukocyte infiltration in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid in infected mice. Collectively, these findings suggest that the TMPRSS2/PAR-2 axis may contribute to influenza-associated lung pathology, providing useful insights into host-targeted protease inhibition as a potential strategy to alleviate severe influenza-induced acute lung injury.

In this study, we investigated the potential involvement of the host protease TMPRSS2 and its downstream partner protease-activated receptor-2 (PAR-2) in modulating MMP-9 expression during A/WSN/33(H1N1) infection. Our findings indicate that viral infection is accompanied by TMPRSS2-mediated PAR-2 activation, alongside downstream engagement of the MEK/ERK and PI3K/AKT signaling pathways and enhanced NF-κB activity, correlating with elevated MMP-9 levels. Pharmacological inhibition of TMPRSS2 with Camostat suppressed PAR-2 activation, attenuated downstream kinase phosphorylation in vitro and in vivo, and was associated with reduced MMP-9 production. Importantly, without apparent alterations in pulmonary viral replication kinetics, TMPRSS2 inhibition helped preserve ECM integrity, mitigated transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER) decline, attenuated alveolar vascular leakage, and reduced inflammatory cytokine release and leukocyte infiltration in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid in infected mice. Collectively, these findings suggest that the TMPRSS2/PAR-2 axis may contribute to influenza-associated lung pathology, providing useful insights into host-targeted protease inhibition as a potential strategy to alleviate severe influenza-induced acute lung injury.
papers.abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒引起的严重急性肺损伤(ALI)以肺泡通透性过高为特征,其中基质金属蛋白酶-9(MMP-9)与细胞外基质(ECM)降解和上皮屏障受损密切相关。然而,涉及病毒相关 MMP-9 上调的 宿主 调节机制仍不完全清楚。在这项研究中,我们研究了 宿主 蛋白酶 TMPRSS2 及其下游伙伴蛋白酶激活受体 2 (PAR-2) 在 A/WSN/33(H1N1) 感染期间调节 MMP-9 表达的潜在参与。我们的研究结果表明,病毒感染伴随着 TMPRSS2 介导的 PAR-2 激活,以及 MEK/ERK 和 PI3K/AKT 信号通路的下游参与以及增强的 NF-κB 活性,与升高的 MMP-9 水平相关。用卡莫司他对 TMPRSS2 进行药理学抑制可抑制 PAR-2 激活,在体外和体内减弱下游激酶磷酸化,并与 MMP-9 产量减少相关。重要的是,在不明显改变肺部病毒复制动力学的情况下,TMPRSS2 抑制有助于保持 ECM 完整性,减轻跨上皮电阻 (TEER) 下降,减弱肺泡血管渗漏,并减少受感染小鼠支气管肺泡灌洗液中炎症细胞因子的释放和白细胞浸润。总的来说,这些发现表明 TMPRSS2/PAR-2 轴可能有助于流感相关的肺部病理学,为 宿主 靶向蛋白酶抑制作为减轻严重流感引起的急性肺损伤的潜在策略提供了有用的见解。

papers.title: Influenza type and subtype dynamics and temporal concordance with regional surveillance: a 65-month retrospective analysis of pediatric inpatient test records
papers.abstract: Routine molecular testing provides influenza type and subtype results, but their value for describing long-term patterns in hospitalized children and comparing these patterns with regional surveillance remains unclear. We analyzed 21,965 throat-swab testing records from 17,835 pediatric and neonatal inpatients aged 0–14 years with clinician-recorded lower respiratory tract infection from January 2021 to May 2026, using a 7-day deduplication rule. We summarized positivity for A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and influenza B and compared the leading categories identified by crude and age-standardized positivity for the five complete calendar years (2021–2025). We assessed age associations using multivariable logistic regression with patient-clustered robust standard errors. We compared the hospital’s monthly category composition with aggregate surveillance data for southern China from the Chinese National Influenza Center (CNIC). Positivity was 2.51% for A(H1N1)pdm09, 3.34% for A(H3N2), and 2.18% for influenza B. Annual leading categories changed several times between 2021 and 2025, and crude and age-standardized positivity identified the same leading category within each year. Compared with children aged < 1 year, adjusted odds ratios for children aged 6–14 years were 1.58, 5.94, and 4.23, respectively. The interaction between category and age group was significant ( P < 0.001). In the 47 concurrent months with composition defined in both series, Pearson r values for the three categories were 0.765, 0.662, and 0.895, respectively. The two series identified the same leading category in 35 of the 44 months with a unique leading category in both series (79.5%, Cohen’s κ = 0.693). Annual leading influenza categories changed several times among tested inpatients, and the strength of the age association differed across categories. The hospital and CNIC southern China monthly shares were positively correlated for all three categories. Routine inpatient testing can supplement regional influenza surveillance with local, age-stratified detection data by type and subtype.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed 21,965 throat-swab testing records from pediatric and neonatal inpatients aged 0–14 years in a hospital in southern China over a 65-month period to assess the dynamics of influenza type and subtype positivity and its correlation with regional surveillance data. The researchers found that the annual leading influenza categories changed several times between 2021 and 2025, with varying strengths of age associations. Positivity rates were 2.51% for A(H1N1)pdm09, 3.34% for A(H3N2), and 2.18% for influenza B. The study highlights the potential of routine inpatient testing to provide age-stratified detection data that can complement regional influenza surveillance. However, the interaction between category and age group was significant, indicating potential confounding factors. The evidence is moderate, as the study is based on retrospective data and does not include prospective or experimental methods.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 常规分子检测可提供流感类型和亚型结果,但其对于描述住院儿童的长期模式以及将这些模式与区域 监测 进行比较的价值仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用 7 天重复数据删除规则,分析了 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 5 月期间临床医生记录的下呼吸道感染的 17,835 名 0-14 岁儿科和新生儿住院患者的 21,965 份咽拭子检测记录。
elements_zh.methods: 我们总结了 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒 和乙型流感的阳性率,并比较了五个完整日历年(2021-2025)的粗略阳性率和年龄标准化阳性率确定的主要类别。
elements_zh.main_results: 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 的阳性率为 2.51%,甲型H3N2流感病毒 的阳性率为 3.34%,乙型流感的阳性率为 2.18%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 2021 年至 2025 年间,年度领先类别发生了数次变化,不同类别的年龄关联强度也有所不同。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 类别和年龄组之间的交互作用显着(P < 0.001)。

papers.abstract_zh: 常规分子检测可提供流感类型和亚型结果,但其对于描述住院儿童的长期模式以及将这些模式与区域 监测 进行比较的价值仍不清楚。我们使用 7 天重复数据删除规则,分析了 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 5 月期间临床医生记录的下呼吸道感染的 17,835 名 0-14 岁儿科和新生儿住院患者的 21,965 份咽拭子检测记录。我们总结了 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒 和乙型流感的阳性率,并比较了五个完整日历年(2021-2025)的粗略阳性率和年龄标准化阳性率确定的主要类别。我们使用多变量逻辑回归和患者聚类稳健标准误来评估年龄关联。我们将医院的每月类别构成与中国国家流感中心 (CNIC) 的华南地区 监测 汇总数据进行了比较。甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 的阳性率为 2.51%,甲型H3N2流感病毒 的阳性率为 3.34%,B 型流感的阳性率为 2.18%。2021 年至 2025 年间,年度主要类别发生了多次变化,粗略和年龄标准化阳性率在每年内都确定了相同的主要类别。与< 1岁儿童相比,6-14岁儿童的调整优势比分别为1.58、5.94和4.23。类别和年龄组之间的交互作用显着(P<0.001)。在同时定义了两个系列组成的 47 个月份中,三个类别的 Pearson r 值分别为 0.765、0.662 和 0.895。这两个系列在 44 个月中的 35 个月中确定了相同的领先类别,并且两个系列中都有一个独特的领先类别(79.5%,Cohen’s κ = 0.693)。在接受测试的住院患者中,年度主要流感类别发生了多次变化,而且不同类别之间年龄关联的强度也有所不同。医院和 CNIC 华南地区的月度股票在所有三个类别中均呈正相关。常规住院患者检测可以补充区域性流感 监测 的本地、按类型和亚型按年龄分层的检测数据。

papers.title: Earth-Abundant Kaolin Derived Antiviral Coating via Triple Synergistic Capture-Inactivate-Block Mechanism.
papers.abstract: Antiviral coating translation is constrained by additive aggregation and resin incompatibility. We upgrade natural kaolin into an efficient antiviral additive via thermal activation and one-pot ball milling with copper precursors, yielding amorphous metakaolin uniformly decorated with copper particles (Cu Ps). This solvent-free protocol suppresses Cu Ps agglomeration and ensures homogeneous dispersion within silicone-acrylic binders, essential for coating integrity. The metakaolin scaffold serves as a high-affinity viral capture platform, while anchored Cu Ps synergistically generate superoxide radicals (•O2-) and sustain localized Cu+/Cu2+ release, enabling dual-modal oxidative inactivation. Combined with the resin's physical barrier, this capture-oxidize-block mechanism delivers >99.9% inactivation of influenza A H3N2 and enterovirus EV-71 under ambient conditions. The composite supports kilogram-scale production (2.22 kg batch), maintains full activity after >6000 washing cycles, and passes dermal safety tests. This work transforms a low-cost clay mineral into a structurally engineered antiviral material and provides a scalable route that overcomes persistent manufacturability and durability limitations in surface protection.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel antiviral coating derived from kaolin, utilizing a triple synergistic capture-inactivate-block mechanism. The research aimed to overcome challenges in antiviral coating development, such as additive aggregation and resin incompatibility, by creating a solvent-free protocol that upgrades kaolin into an efficient antiviral additive. The method involved thermal activation and ball milling with copper precursors to produce a material with homogeneous dispersion of copper particles within silicone-acrylic binders. The results showed that the metakaolin scaffold captures viruses, while the copper particles generate oxidative inactivation. The authors interpreted this as a significant advancement in antiviral surface protection, with the coating demonstrating >99.9% inactivation of influenza A H3N2 and EV-71 under ambient conditions. The findings suggest potential applications in public health for durable and scalable antiviral materials. However, the evidence is based solely on abstract-level reporting, and further experimental validation is needed to confirm these results in real-world settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决 抗病毒药物 涂层开发的局限性,特别是阻碍 抗病毒药物 有效转化的添加剂聚集和树脂不相容性的挑战。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这一发现解释为一种新颖的三重协同捕获-灭活-阻断机制,可在环境条件下有效灭活甲型 H3N2 流感和肠道病毒 EV-71。

papers.title_zh: 地球上丰富的高岭土衍生 抗病毒药物 涂层通过三重协同捕获-失活-阻断机制。

papers.abstract_zh: 抗病毒药物 涂层转化受到添加剂聚集和树脂不相容性的限制。我们通过热活化和与铜前体的一锅球磨将天然高岭土升级为高效的 抗病毒药物 添加剂,产生均匀装饰有铜颗粒 (Cu Ps) 的无定形偏高岭土。这种无溶剂方案可抑制 Cu Ps 团聚,并确保有机硅丙烯酸粘合剂中的均匀分散,这对于涂层的完整性至关重要。偏高岭土支架充当高亲和力的病毒捕获平台,而锚定的Cu Ps协同产生超氧自由基(•O2-)并维持局部Cu+/Cu2+释放,从而实现双模式氧化失活。与树脂的物理屏障相结合,这种捕获-氧化-阻断机制在环境条件下可实现 >99.9% 的甲型流感 H3N2 和肠道病毒 EV-71 灭活。该复合材料支持公斤级生产(批量 2.22 公斤),在超过 6000 次洗涤循环后仍保持完整活性,并通过皮肤安全测试。这项工作将低成本粘土矿物转化为结构工程 抗病毒药物 材料,并提供了一种可扩展的路线,克服了表面保护方面持续的可制造性和耐久性限制。

papers.title: Strain-specific influenza vaccine immunogenicity in adults with severe asthma receiving biologic therapy: a real-world baseline-adjusted HAI study
papers.abstract: Background Evidence on influenza vaccine immunogenicity during biologic treatment for severe asthma remains limited, particularly in adults treated in routine clinical practice. Methods In this prospective single-centre observational study, we analysed pre- and post-vaccination haemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) titres in 147 adults with asthma who received Grippol Quadrivalent during the 2023–2024 season: 126 patients with severe asthma receiving ongoing biologic therapy and 21 asthma controls not receiving biologic therapy. Blood was obtained before vaccination and 4–6 weeks after vaccination. For each vaccine strain, log2(post-vaccination HAI) was modelled using analysis of covariance with study group and the corresponding log2(pre-vaccination HAI) titre as predictors. The group coefficient was back-transformed to an adjusted geometric mean ratio (GMR; biologic therapy/control). Results Adjusted GMRs were 0.61 (95% CI 0.33–1.13; P = 0.113) for A/H1N1/Victoria, 1.08 (0.64–1.81; P = 0.779) for A/H3N2/Darwin, 0.46 (0.23–0.94; P = 0.032) for B/Austria, and 0.59 (0.34–1.05; P = 0.073) for B/Phuket. Conclusion Baseline-adjusted estimates differed numerically across strains, but between-strain heterogeneity was not formally tested.B/Austria yielded a nominally lower adjusted titre (P = 0.032; Holm-adjusted P = 0.128), but not after additional adjustment for age and sex (GMR 0.54, 95% CI 0.28–1.05; P = 0.068); confidence intervals for the other three strains included unity; all findings are exploratory. These observational data extend randomized evidence from individual biologics to an adult real-world severe-asthma cohort.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the immunogenicity of seasonal influenza vaccines in adults with severe asthma receiving biologic therapy. It is a real-world, prospective, single-centre observational study involving 147 participants, including 126 with severe asthma on biologics and 21 asthma controls. Pre- and post-vaccination HAI titres were measured, and adjusted geometric mean ratios (GMRs) were calculated using analysis of covariance. The results showed varying GMRs across strains, with B/Austria showing a nominally lower titre (P = 0.032) but not after adjustment for age and sex. Confidence intervals for the other strains included unity, indicating no significant difference. The study highlights the need for further research on vaccine effectiveness in this population, as all findings are exploratory. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational design and lack of formal testing for between-strain differences.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景 关于流感 疫苗 治疗严重哮喘的生物制剂 疫苗 免疫原性的证据仍然有限,特别是在常规临床实践中治疗的成人中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项前瞻性单中心观察性研究中,我们分析了 2023-2024 年期间接受 Grippol 四价治疗的 147 名成人哮喘患者在 疫苗接种 治疗前和治疗后的血凝抑制 (HAI) 滴度:126 名严重哮喘患者正在接受持续的生物治疗,21 名哮喘对照患者未接受生物治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 在疫苗接种之前和疫苗接种之后4-6周采集血液。对于每个 疫苗 菌株,使用研究组的协方差分析对 log2(疫苗接种 HAI 后)进行建模,并将相应的 log2(疫苗接种 HAI 前)滴度作为预测因子。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 将组系数反向转换为调整后的几何平均比(GMR;生物治疗/对照)。这些观察数据将随机证据从个体生物制剂扩展到现实世界的成人严重哮喘 队列研究。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Baseline-adjusted estimates differed numerically across strains, but between-strain heterogeneity was not formally tested. B/Austria yielded a nominally lower adjusted titre (P = 0.032; Holm-adjusted P = 0.128), but not after additional adjustment for age and sex (GMR 0.54, 95% CI 0.28–1.05; P = 0.068); confidence intervals for the other three strains included unity; all findings are exploratory.
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所有发现都是探索性的,其他三种菌株的置信区间包括统一性。该研究是观察性的,并未正式测试菌株间的异质性。

papers.source_body_en: Background Evidence on influenza vaccine immunogenicity during biologic treatment for severe asthma remains limited, particularly in adults treated in routine clinical practice. Methods In this prospective single-centre observational study, we analysed pre- and post-vaccination haemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) titres in 147 adults with asthma who received Grippol Quadrivalent during the 2023–2024 season: 126 patients with severe asthma receiving ongoing biologic therapy and 21 asthma controls not receiving biologic therapy. Blood was obtained before vaccination and 4–6 weeks after vaccination. For each vaccine strain, log2(post-vaccination HAI) was modelled using analysis of covariance with study group and the corresponding log2(pre-vaccination HAI) titre as predictors. The group coefficient was back-transformed to an adjusted geometric mean ratio (GMR; biologic therapy/control). Results Adjusted GMRs were 0.61 (95% CI 0.33–1.13; P = 0.113) for A/H1N1/Victoria, 1.08 (0.64–1.81; P = 0.779) for A/H3N2/Darwin, 0.46 (0.23–0.94; P = 0.032) for B/Austria, and 0.59 (0.34–1.05; P = 0.073) for B/Phuket. Conclusion Baseline-adjusted estimates differed numerically across strains, but between-strain heterogeneity was not formally tested.B/Austria yielded a nominally lower adjusted titre (P = 0.032; Holm-adjusted P = 0.128), but not after additional adjustment for age and sex (GMR 0.54, 95% CI 0.28–1.05; P = 0.068); confidence intervals for the other three strains included unity; all findings are exploratory. These observational data extend randomized evidence from individual biologics to an adult real-world severe-asthma cohort.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景 关于流感 疫苗 治疗严重哮喘的生物制剂 疫苗 免疫原性的证据仍然有限,特别是在常规临床实践中治疗的成人中。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项前瞻性单中心观察性研究中,我们分析了 2023-2024 年期间接受 Grippol 四价治疗的 147 名成人哮喘患者在 疫苗接种 治疗前和治疗后的血凝抑制 (HAI) 滴度:126 名严重哮喘患者正在接受持续的生物治疗,21 名哮喘对照患者未接受生物治疗。
analysis_zh.methods: 在疫苗接种之前和疫苗接种之后4-6周采集血液。对于每个 疫苗 菌株,使用研究组的协方差分析对 log2(疫苗接种 HAI 后)进行建模,并将相应的 log2(疫苗接种 HAI 前)滴度作为预测因子。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 将组系数反向转换为调整后的几何平均比(GMR;生物治疗/对照)。这些观察数据将随机证据从个体生物制剂扩展到现实世界的成人严重哮喘 队列研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所有发现都是探索性的,其他三种菌株的置信区间包括统一性。该研究是观察性的,并未正式测试菌株间的异质性。

papers.title: Epidemiological characteristics of 11 respiratory pathogens among 19,382 hospitalized children in Putian city
papers.abstract: Objective To analyze the epidemiological characteristics of common respiratory pathogens among children hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs) in Putian city with the aim of providing a scientific basis for regional pediatric respiratory infection prevention. Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted on clinical data from 19,382 children hospitalized at the Affiliated Hospital of Putian University between January 1, 2023, and December 30, 2025. Multiplex polymerase chain reaction (PCR) combined with capillary electrophoresis fragment analysis was employed to detect 11 common respiratory pathogens. Results A total of 19,382 hospitalized children were enrolled, with an overall respiratory pathogen positivity rate of 69.40%. The positivity rate was highest among preschool-aged children and lowest among adolescents. Mycoplasma pneumoniae (Mp) exhibited the highest detection rate in school-aged children (38.57%), while human respiratory syncytial virus (HRSV) demonstrated the highest detection rate in infants and toddlers (19.53%). The pathogen positivity rate was 70.24% in males and 68.20% in females, with a statistically significant difference between sexes. Among the 19,382 children with ARTIs, single-pathogen detection predominated, accounting for 58.89%; dual-pathogen detection accounted for 9.93%, and multiple-pathogen detection accounted for 0.57%. Respiratory pathogen positivity rates showed seasonal fluctuations, peaking in winter 2023 (73.98%), spring 2024 (77.85%), and autumn 2025 (74.17%). In addition, the positivity rates of influenza A virus (InfA), influenza B virus (InfB) decreased with increasing temperature, whereas those of HRSV, human coronavirus (HCOV) increased with increasing temperature. A total of 15,601 pathogen detection events were recorded; the three most frequently detected pathogens were human rhinovirus (HRV; 24.66%), Mp (23.68%), and HRSV (14.52%). Conclusion The overall positivity rate of respiratory pathogens among children hospitalized with ARTIs in Putian was high (69.40%), with distinct age-related and seasonal characteristics. Mp predominated in school-aged children, whereas HRSV predominated in infants and toddlers. Pathogen detection peaked in autumn–winter 2023, spring 2024, and autumn 2025. HRV, Mp, and HRSV were the three dominant pathogens. The dual- and multiple-detection groups had median hospital stays of 6 days, compared with 5 days in the pathogen-negative and single-detection groups. These findings provide a scientific basis for optimizing clinical diagnosis and treatment of pediatric respiratory infections in this region.
papers.journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the epidemiological characteristics of 11 respiratory pathogens among 19,382 hospitalized children in Putian city between 2023 and 2025. It found that the overall positivity rate of respiratory pathogens was 69.40%, with preschool-aged children showing the highest positivity rate and adolescents the lowest. Mycoplasma pneumoniae (Mp) was most prevalent in school-aged children, while human respiratory syncytial virus (HRSV) was most common in infants and toddlers. The positivity rates of influenza A virus (InfA) and influenza B virus (InfB) decreased with increasing temperature, whereas those of HRSV and human coronavirus (HCOV) increased. The study also noted seasonal fluctuations, with peaks in winter 2023, spring 2024, and autumn 2025. These findings provide insights into the age-related and seasonal distribution of respiratory pathogens, which can inform clinical diagnosis and treatment strategies in the region. However, the study's retrospective design limits the strength of its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在分析莆田市急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)住院儿童常见呼吸道病原体的流行病学特征,为区域小儿呼吸道感染的预防提供科学依据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2023年1月1日至2025年12月30日莆田学院附属医院住院的19382名儿童的临床资料进行回顾性分析。
elements_zh.methods: 采用多重聚合酶链反应(PCR)结合毛细管电泳片段分析检测11种常见呼吸道病原体。
elements_zh.main_results: 共纳入19382名住院儿童,呼吸道病原体总体阳性率为69.40%。学龄前儿童的阳性率最高,青少年最低。学龄儿童中肺炎支原体(Mp)检出率最高(38.57%),婴幼儿中人呼吸道合胞病毒(HRSV)检出​​率最高(19.53%)。呼吸道病原体阳性率呈现季节性波动,峰值出现在2023年冬季(73.98%)、2024年春季(77.85%)和2025年秋季(74.17%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了莆田市 ARTI 住院儿童呼吸道病原体与年龄和季节的明显特征,为这些病原体的分布模式提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些研究结果为优化该地区小儿呼吸道感染临床诊断和治疗提供了科学依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性数据,这可能会引入偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力。由于该研究的观察性质,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Vaccine responses to influenza viruses and SARS-CoV-2 under novel immunotherapies in myasthenia gravis and CIDP: a prospective observational study
papers.abstract: Abstract Patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP) require long-term immunotherapy, making effective vaccination essential for infection prophylaxis. As these immunotherapies increasingly involve novel agents such as FcRn antagonists and complement inhibitors, their influence on the vaccine response needs to be assessed. Therefore, we prospectively enrolled 23 patients with MG or CIDP receiving contemporary immunotherapies who were vaccinated against influenza viruses ( n = 21; Northern Hemisphere 2025/26) or SARS-CoV-2 ( n = 12). Sera collected before and at least two weeks after vaccination were assayed for antibodies against the SARS-CoV-2 spike S1 subunit and three influenza strains. A response to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination (≥ 2-fold increase in anti-S1 IgG) was observed in 9 of 12 patients (75%; median fold-change 2.6), and influenza seroprotection rates (haemagglutination inhibition [HAI] titer ≥ 1:40) rose for all three strains reaching 86% (A/H1N1), 76% (B/Victoria), and 67% (A/H3N2). The effect of individual medications on post-vaccination titers was assessed by analysis of covariance (ANCOVA), adjusting for baseline titer and diagnosis. In these exploratory models, estimates were directionally higher under ravulizumab and lower under efgartigimod and mycophenolate; none remained statistically significant after correction for multiple testing. Patients receiving efgartigimod and mycophenolate concurrently had significantly lower absolute post-vaccination HAI titers for A/H1N1 (median 1:30 vs. 1:160; p = 0.0085) and A/H3N2 (median < 1:10 vs. These findings are consistent with lower baseline and circulating antibody levels and do not show a detectable difference in fold-change in this small exploratory cohort. Patients who failed to seroconvert to any strain were more frequently receiving FcRn antagonists, yet most retained seroprotection against at least one strain. Under FcRn antagonism, influenza titers did not parallel total serum IgG, with several patients seroconverting despite a concurrent decline in total IgG. In conclusion, most patients mounted a measurable humoral response to both vaccines despite contemporary immunotherapy.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess vaccine responses to seasonal influenza viruses and SARS-CoV-2 in patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP) undergoing immunotherapy, as these patients require long-term treatment and effective vaccination is essential for infection prevention.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This prospective observational study enrolled 23 patients with MG or CIDP receiving contemporary immunotherapies, who were vaccinated against influenza viruses (n = 21; Northern Hemisphere 2025/26) or SARS-CoV-2 (n = 12).
analysis.methods: The effect of individual medications on post-vaccination antibody titers was evaluated using analysis of covariance (ANCOVA), adjusting for baseline titer and diagnosis.
analysis.main_results: A response to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination (≥ 2-fold increase in anti-S1 IgG) was observed in 9 of 12 patients (75%; median fold-change 2.6), and influenza seroprotection rates (HAI titer ≥ 1:40) increased for all three strains, reaching 86% (A/H1N1), 76% (B/Victoria), and 67% (A/H3N2).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that most patients mounted a measurable humoral response to both vaccines despite receiving contemporary immunotherapy, highlighting the importance of understanding vaccine efficacy in immunocompromised populations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for tailored vaccination strategies in patients with autoimmune diseases undergoing immunotherapy, particularly for seasonal influenza and SARS-CoV-2.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is exploratory with a small cohort, and none of the estimates remained statistically significant after multiple testing correction, indicating limited evidence strength.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective observational study evaluated vaccine responses to seasonal influenza viruses and SARS-CoV-2 in patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP) undergoing immunotherapy. The study enrolled 23 patients, with 21 receiving influenza vaccines and 12 receiving SARS-CoV-2 vaccines. A response to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination was observed in 75% of patients, while influenza seroprotection rates reached 86%, 76%, and 67% for A/H1N1, B/Victoria, and A/H3N2 strains, respectively. The authors interpreted that most patients mounted a measurable humoral response to both vaccines despite immunotherapy, which has implications for vaccination strategies in immunocompromised individuals. However, the study's small size and lack of statistical significance after multiple testing correction limit confidence in the findings, suggesting moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估接受免疫治疗的重症肌无力(MG)和慢性炎症性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病(CIDP)患者对季节性流感病毒和SARS-CoV-2的疫苗反应,因为这些患者需要长期治疗,而有效的疫苗接种对于预防感染至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项前瞻性观察性研究招募了 23 名接受当代免疫疗法的 MG 或 CIDP 患者,他们接种了流感病毒疫苗(n = 21;北半球 2025/26)或 SARS-CoV-2(n = 12)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用协方差分析 (ANCOVA)、调整基线滴度和 诊断 来评估个体药物对 疫苗接种 后抗体滴度的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 12 名患者中有 9 名观察到对 SARS-CoV-2 疫苗接种 的反应(抗 S1 IgG 增加≥2 倍)(75%;中位倍数变化 2.6),所有三种病毒株的流感血清保护率(HAI 滴度≥1:40)均增加,达到 86%(A/H1N1)、76%(B/维多利亚)和 67% (A/H3N2)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,尽管接受了当代免疫治疗,大多数患者对 疫苗 都产生了可测量的体液反应,这强调了了解 疫苗 在免疫功能低下人群中疗效的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,对于接受免疫治疗的自身免疫性疾病患者,特别是 季节性流感 和 SARS-CoV-2,需要制定量身定制的 疫苗接种 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是探索性的,队列研究 较小,经过多次检验校正后,所有估计值均未保持统计显着性,表明证据强度有限。

papers.title_zh: 疫苗 在重症肌无力和 CIDP 新型免疫疗法下对流感病毒和 SARS-CoV-2 的反应:一项前瞻性观察研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP) require long-term immunotherapy, making effective vaccination essential for infection prophylaxis. As these immunotherapies increasingly involve novel agents such as FcRn antagonists and complement inhibitors, their influence on the vaccine response needs to be assessed. Therefore, we prospectively enrolled 23 patients with MG or CIDP receiving contemporary immunotherapies who were vaccinated against influenza viruses ( n = 21; Northern Hemisphere 2025/26) or SARS-CoV-2 ( n = 12). Sera collected before and at least two weeks after vaccination were assayed for antibodies against the SARS-CoV-2 spike S1 subunit and three influenza strains. A response to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination (≥ 2-fold increase in anti-S1 IgG) was observed in 9 of 12 patients (75%; median fold-change 2.6), and influenza seroprotection rates (haemagglutination inhibition [HAI] titer ≥ 1:40) rose for all three strains reaching 86% (A/H1N1), 76% (B/Victoria), and 67% (A/H3N2). The effect of individual medications on post-vaccination titers was assessed by analysis of covariance (ANCOVA), adjusting for baseline titer and diagnosis. In these exploratory models, estimates were directionally higher under ravulizumab and lower under efgartigimod and mycophenolate; none remained statistically significant after correction for multiple testing. Patients receiving efgartigimod and mycophenolate concurrently had significantly lower absolute post-vaccination HAI titers for A/H1N1 (median 1:30 vs. 1:160; p = 0.0085) and A/H3N2 (median < 1:10 vs. These findings are consistent with lower baseline and circulating antibody levels and do not show a detectable difference in fold-change in this small exploratory cohort. Patients who failed to seroconvert to any strain were more frequently receiving FcRn antagonists, yet most retained seroprotection against at least one strain. Under FcRn antagonism, influenza titers did not parallel total serum IgG, with several patients seroconverting despite a concurrent decline in total IgG. In conclusion, most patients mounted a measurable humoral response to both vaccines despite contemporary immunotherapy.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 重症肌无力(MG)和慢性炎症性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病(CIDP)患者需要长期免疫治疗,因此有效的疫苗接种对于感染预防至关重要。由于这些免疫疗法越来越多地涉及 FcRn 拮抗剂和补体抑制剂等新型药物,因此需要评估它们对 疫苗 反应的影响。因此,我们前瞻性地招募了 23 名接受当代免疫疗法的 MG 或 CIDP 患者,这些患者接种了流感病毒 (n = 21;北半球 2025/26) 或 SARS-CoV-2 (n = 12) 疫苗。对 疫苗接种 之前和之后至少两周收集的血清进行了针对 SARS-CoV-2 刺突 S1 亚基和三种流感病毒株的抗体检测。12 名患者中有 9 名观察到对 SARS-CoV-2 疫苗接种 的反应(抗 S1 IgG 增加≥ 2 倍)(75%;中位倍数变化 2.6),所有三种毒株的流感血清保护率(血凝抑制 [HAI] 效价≥ 1:40)均上升,达到 86% (A/H1N1)、76% (B/维多利亚)和 67%(A/H3N2)。通过协方差分析 (ANCOVA)、调整基线滴度和 诊断 来评估个体药物对 疫苗接种 后滴度的影响。在这些探索性模型中,ravulizumab 的估计值明显较高,而 efgartigimod 和麦考酚酯的估计值则较低;经过多次测试校正后,没有一个保持统计学显着性。同时接受 efgartigimod 和麦考酚酯治疗的患者在 疫苗接种 治疗后的 A/H1N1 HAI 滴度绝对值显着降低(中位数 1:30 vs. 1:160;p = 0.0085)和 A/H3N2(中位数 < 1:10 vs.)。这些结果与较低的基线和循环抗体水平一致,并且在这项小型探索性研究中没有显示出可检测到的倍数变化差异。队列研究 未能血清转化为任何毒株的患者更频繁地接受 FcRn 拮抗剂,但大多数患者在 FcRn 拮抗作用下保留了针对至少一种毒株的血清保护,尽管总 IgG 同时下降,但仍有几名患者发生了血清转化。

papers.title: The indole-3-propionic acid-producing bacteria Clostridium sporogenes protects against influenza
papers.abstract: Abstract Gut microbiota, especially bacterial metabolites, play a key role in protecting the lungs against respiratory infections such as influenza A virus (IAV). However, IAV infection can disrupt the gut microbiota, potentially increasing disease severity. Notably, reduced levels of the microbial tryptophan metabolite indole-3-propionic acid (IPA) impair viral control and promote pulmonary inflammation, thereby exacerbating IAV infection. In the current study, we investigated the potential protective effects of Clostridium sporogenes , a human anaerobic commensal and IPA producer previously shown to mitigate metabolic, inflammatory, and neurological disorders, but whose effects during respiratory infection remain unexplored. Relative to untreated mice, C. sporogenes supplementation was associated with less severe disease, lower pulmonary viral loads, and reduced lung inflammation. sporogenes administration modulated infection-induced gut dysbiosis and restored systemic IPA levels, which were positively correlated with reduced clinical scores and pulmonary viral loads. IPA and its analogues failed to exert direct antiviral effects in cell-based assays, suggesting indirect effects on immunity or other host-pathogen interactions. The pregnane X receptor, a xenosensor known to be activated by IPA, was not involved in the protection mediated by C. Lastly, administration of pasteurized C. sporogenes improved influenza outcomes, an effect that also correlated with IPA levels. Collectively, these findings suggest that C. sporogenes may represent a promising next-generation probiotic candidate for the prevention or mitigation of acute viral respiratory infections.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the potential protective effects of Clostridium sporogenes, a human anaerobic commensal and indole-3-propionic acid (IPA) producer, against influenza A virus (IAV) infection, given the role of gut microbiota and its metabolites in lung protection during respiratory infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved mice infected with influenza A virus (IAV) and supplemented with Clostridium sporogenes. The design focused on assessing the impact of this bacterial intervention on disease severity, viral loads, and inflammation in the lungs.
analysis.methods: The researchers administered Clostridium sporogenes to mice and evaluated its effects on pulmonary viral loads, inflammation, and gut microbiota composition. They also tested the direct antiviral effects of IPA and its analogues in cell-based assays.
analysis.main_results: Clostridium sporogenes supplementation was associated with less severe disease, lower pulmonary viral loads, and reduced lung inflammation compared to untreated mice. The administration of pasteurized C. sporogenes also improved influenza outcomes, correlating with restored systemic IPA levels.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that C. sporogenes may modulate gut dysbiosis and enhance systemic IPA levels, which are linked to reduced disease severity and viral loads, indicating a novel indirect mechanism of protection against influenza.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the potential of C. sporogenes as a probiotic candidate for the prevention or mitigation of acute viral respiratory infections, offering a new avenue for therapeutic strategies targeting gut-lung interactions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to animal models, and the indirect effects of IPA on influenza outcomes require further validation in human studies. The evidence is moderate due to the lack of direct antiviral effects observed in cell-based assays.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the protective effects of Clostridium sporogenes, a human gut bacterium that produces indole-3-propionic acid (IPA), against influenza A virus (IAV) infection. The research is motivated by the understanding that gut microbiota and its metabolites play a critical role in lung immunity. Using a mouse model, the study demonstrates that C. sporogenes supplementation reduces disease severity, lowers pulmonary viral loads, and decreases lung inflammation. These effects are associated with the restoration of systemic IPA levels, which are positively correlated with improved outcomes. However, IPA itself does not show direct antiviral activity in cell-based assays, suggesting indirect immune modulation. The findings propose C. sporogenes as a potential probiotic for preventing or mitigating acute viral respiratory infections, though the results are based on animal models and require further human validation. The evidence is considered moderate due to the limitations in direct antiviral mechanisms and generalizability.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及感染流感A病毒(IAV)并补充Clostridium sporogenes的小鼠。研究设计重点在于评估这种细菌干预对疾病严重程度、病毒载量和肺部炎症的影响。

elements_zh.main_results: 与未治疗的小鼠相比,补充Clostridium sporogenes与较轻的疾病、较低的肺部病毒载量和较少的肺部炎症相关。灭活的C. sporogenes的给药也改善了流感结果,这种效果与系统性IPA水平的恢复相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,C. sporogenes可能调节肠道菌群失调并增强系统性IPA水平,这些水平与疾病严重程度和病毒载量的降低相关,表明其对流感的保护作用可能通过一种新的间接机制实现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果突显了C. sporogenes作为预防或缓解急性病毒性呼吸道感染的益生菌候选物的潜力,为针对肠道-肺部相互作用的治疗策略提供了新的途径。

The administration of pasteurized C. sporogenes also improved influenza outcomes, correlating with restored systemic IPA levels.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that C. sporogenes may modulate gut dysbiosis and enhance systemic IPA levels, which are linked to reduced disease severity and viral loads, indicating a novel indirect mechanism of protection against influenza.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the potential of C. sporogenes as a probiotic candidate for the prevention or mitigation of acute viral respiratory infections, offering a new avenue for therapeutic strategies targeting gut-lung interactions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to animal models, and the indirect effects of IPA on influenza outcomes require further validation in human studies. The evidence is moderate due to the lack of direct antiviral effects observed in cell-based assays.

papers.title_zh: 产吲哚 3-丙酸细菌 产孢梭菌可预防流感
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Gut microbiota, especially bacterial metabolites, play a key role in protecting the lungs against respiratory infections such as influenza A virus (IAV). However, IAV infection can disrupt the gut microbiota, potentially increasing disease severity. Notably, reduced levels of the microbial tryptophan metabolite indole-3-propionic acid (IPA) impair viral control and promote pulmonary inflammation, thereby exacerbating IAV infection. In the current study, we investigated the potential protective effects of Clostridium sporogenes , a human anaerobic commensal and IPA producer previously shown to mitigate metabolic, inflammatory, and neurological disorders, but whose effects during respiratory infection remain unexplored. Relative to untreated mice, C. sporogenes supplementation was associated with less severe disease, lower pulmonary viral loads, and reduced lung inflammation. sporogenes administration modulated infection-induced gut dysbiosis and restored systemic IPA levels, which were positively correlated with reduced clinical scores and pulmonary viral loads. IPA and its analogues failed to exert direct antiviral effects in cell-based assays, suggesting indirect effects on immunity or other host-pathogen interactions. The pregnane X receptor, a xenosensor known to be activated by IPA, was not involved in the protection mediated by C. Lastly, administration of pasteurized C. sporogenes improved influenza outcomes, an effect that also correlated with IPA levels. Collectively, these findings suggest that C. sporogenes may represent a promising next-generation probiotic candidate for the prevention or mitigation of acute viral respiratory infections.
